vista.titulo: Apply to join a job pool
vista.ayuda: Check job pools with open application periods and their requirements. Review the pool before applying. You can then check the status under My applications.
vista.error: We could not complete the request. Check your connection and select Try again. If the problem continues, contact the support office.
vista.temporal: This information is temporarily unavailable. Wait a few minutes and select Try again. If the problem continues, contact the support office.
vista.envioTemporal: We could not confirm the submission. Select Submit application again to check it, or check My applications later.
vista.datosNoAceptados: The application details were not accepted. Refresh the call before submitting again. If the problem continues, contact the support office.
vista.sinSesion: Sign in again to view or submit your application.
vista.denegada: Your access does not allow this request. Contact the support office for help.
vista.noEncontrada: This job pool or application is no longer available. Return to the list and refresh it.
vista.noDisponible: Applications to job pools are not open at the moment. Please check again later.
vista.conflicto: The job pool has changed or an application already exists. Check My applications before trying again.
vista.plazoCerrado: The application period or requirements have changed. Return to the list and check the updated details.
vista.vacio: There are no job pools open for applications now. Please check again later.
vista.sinSolicitudes: You have not submitted an application yet.
vista.sinCategorias: No categories match. Try another name.
vista.sinRequisitos: This job pool lists no additional requirements.
vista.revisarActo: You will apply to join this job pool. Human Resources will review whether you meet the requirements.
vista.revisarPendiente: We are checking the previous submission. You can retry with the same details or check My applications.
vista.envioComprobar: The previous submission has finished. Check My applications for the result.
vista.declarar: I declare that I meet this requirement
vista.sinDeclaraciones: You have not selected any requirement. You can still apply; Human Resources will review them.
vista.requisitosCambiados: The requirements or details have changed. Check the job pool before trying again.
vista.registrada: Application submitted. You can check its status and receipt on this page.
vista.estado_admitida_a_convocatoria: Accepted. Awaiting entry into the job pool
vista.paso_pendiente: Human Resources will review your application. Check this page for the decision.
vista.paso_admitida_a_convocatoria: Human Resources has accepted your application. Entry into the job pool awaits the final list.
vista.paso_incorporada: Your entry in the job pool is recorded. Check My pool for your current status.
vista.paso_rechazada: If you need clarification about the decision, contact the support office.
